hero-violet.$description: Hero Violet — Hero section background, full-bleed brand wash — saturated lavender makes the page unmistakable from a thumbnail

card-lilac.$description: Card Lilac — Card and panel surfaces — desaturated companion to Hero Violet, used for elevated content blocks on the lighter canvas

bitcoin-orange.$description: Bitcoin Orange — Accent for the Bitcoin currency icon and selective callouts — the only warm chromatic note in a cool palette, anchoring the crypto identity

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Footer band and warm transitions — breaks the lavender monotony with a peach-tinged neutral

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Page canvas — the dominant background across most sections, a barely-there violet tint instead of pure white

off-white.$description: Off-White — Footer base surface, light secondary backgrounds

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Button text, inverse surfaces, card highlights on colored backgrounds

ink-plum.$description: Ink Plum — Primary text, filled button backgrounds, dark borders — near-black with a violet undertone that keeps it on-palette

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary headings, link text, subdued body copy

slate.$description: Slate — Muted helper text, captions, tertiary metadata

steel.$description: Steel — Icon strokes, button text on light surfaces, mid-emphasis labels

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines — the universal 1px rule throughout the UI

fog.$description: Fog — Button borders, disabled-state surfaces, secondary dividers

jet.$description: Jet — Maximum-contrast text, logo marks, hard-edge elements where Ink Plum feels too soft

sharp-grotesk-bold.$description: Display headlines for brand words ('NURI', 'BACK.') — extreme weight 900 with tight tracking creates a stencil/spray-paint impact that contrasts deliberately with the serif body of the same headline. At 118px it fills the hero column; the 0.018em positive tracking at that size is unusual and prevents the slabs from merging at extreme scale.

harriet-display.$description: Editorial serif used for headline companions ('BANK IS', 'One Tap. You're In.'), feature section headings, and the hero subhead — weight 300 at 50–62px is a restrained, magazine-display choice that creates tension with the 900-weight sans beside it. The 0.90 line-height at display sizes keeps stacked lines touching like fine print.

inter.$description: Workhorse for body, navigation, buttons, inputs, footer copy, card text — weight 400 for body, 500 for nav/links, 600 for subheadings and button labels. The tight 1.20–1.33 range for 20–32px sizes keeps mid-scale text compact and confident.
